result_summary: Implement solve(xs: list[int]) -> int. The result must satisfy both of the following for every input list. (1) Strict monotonicity: if you append any positive integer to the list, the result must strictly increase. (2) Bounded residue: the result must always be congruent to the list length modulo 5,
